mechanism.claim: When high versus low quote-turnover five-minute auctions consistently precede signed price responses in one direction during a completed high-variation BTC block, activity is leading directional price discovery rather than merely accompanying it. If the lead-response sign agrees with completed displacement, follow that direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of turnover-to-next-return correlation and completed eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTLRR correlates current log quote turnover with the following bar's signed return. LFIC uses signed aggressive-flow imbalance; HVVRCR uses contemporaneous return-volume covariance; HVSRP uses absolute return shocks; HVTCCR uses turnover-share HHI without lagged response. No event set, diagnostic control, fitted outcome, funding, OI, premium, or cross-asset input is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail selects volatile blocks while a turnover-leading response tail identifies staged information transmission
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily turnover-lead onsets with eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates from 480 unique one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.bar_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume in each group, finite nonnegative
features.lead_response: sample Pearson correlation of turnover_coordinate[t] and next_bar_return[t+1] across 95 ordered pairs; both sample standard deviations strict positive; correlation strict nonzero
features.response_strength_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(lead_response) over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute bar returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open), strict nonzero and same sign as lead_response
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no lag, correlation, rank, confirmation, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
